list_child.name: list_catalog_licenses
list_child.desc: Returns every content licensing deal tracked in the catalog system, spanning every stage from negotiation through expiration. This call is intended for pipeline reviews by the content operations team.

decoys.name: list_sublicense_licenses
decoys.desc: Returns every content licensing deal tracked in the regional sublicensing ledger, spanning every stage from negotiation through expiration. This call is intended for territory reviews by the international team.

decoys.name: list_festival_licenses
decoys.desc: Returns every content licensing deal tracked on the festival acquisitions slate, spanning every stage from negotiation through expiration. This call is intended for market prep by the acquisitions team.

decoys.name: list_music_licenses
decoys.desc: Returns every content licensing deal tracked in the music clearance log, spanning every stage from negotiation through expiration. This call is intended for soundtrack reviews by the clearance team.

get_child.name: get_license_record
get_child.desc: Retrieves the deal record for a single licensing deal by its identifier, including its current stage and key dates. Use this when content operations needs to check where one deal stands.

decoys.name: get_license_terms
decoys.desc: Retrieves the contract terms for a single licensing deal by its identifier, including its territories and windows. Use this when legal needs to check what one deal permits.

decoys.name: get_license_royalties
decoys.desc: Retrieves the royalty statement for a single licensing deal by its identifier, including its payments and minimum guarantee. Use this when finance needs to check what one deal has cost.

decoys.name: get_license_deliverables
decoys.desc: Retrieves the delivery checklist for a single licensing deal by its identifier, including its masters and subtitle files. Use this when the media team needs to check what one deal has delivered.

list_parent.name: list_partner_studios
list_parent.desc: Returns every studio on the platform's content partner roster, including both current and past partners. This is useful for surveying who the platform has licensed titles from.

decoys.name: list_prospect_studios
decoys.desc: Returns every studio on the acquisitions team's prospect roster, including both new and returning prospects. This is useful for planning outreach before the next film market.

decoys.name: list_vendor_studios
decoys.desc: Returns every studio on the post-production vendor roster, including dubbing and subtitling houses. This is useful for booking localization work on upcoming titles.

decoys.name: list_coproduction_studios
decoys.desc: Returns every studio on the co-production partner roster, including both current and past co-producers. This is useful for scoping new original productions.

get_parent.name: get_studio_profile
get_parent.desc: Retrieves a single studio's profile by id, including the name on file for that partner. It is the usual first stop before contacting the studio about a deal.

decoys.name: get_studio_contacts
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single studio's contact sheet by id, including the business affairs leads for that partner. It is the usual first stop before a negotiation call.

decoys.name: get_studio_payments
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single studio's payment ledger by id, including the remittances made to that partner. It is the usual first stop before settling a royalty dispute.

decoys.name: get_studio_scorecard
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single studio's delivery scorecard by id, including the on-time rate for that partner. It is the usual first stop before a quarterly business review.

delete_child.name: terminate_license_deal
delete_child.desc: Permanently terminates a licensing deal and removes it from the active catalog pipeline. This action cannot be reversed, so it is used once the termination is confirmed with legal.

decoys.name: purge_license_masters
decoys.desc: Permanently purges the delivered video masters for a licensing deal from the media vault. This action cannot be reversed, so it is used once the rights window has closed for good.

decoys.name: writeoff_license_advance
decoys.desc: Permanently writes off the minimum guarantee advance paid on a licensing deal. This action cannot be reversed, so it is used once finance confirms the loss with the studio.
verbs: write off the guarantee paid for {obj}

decoys.name: revoke_license_sublicenses
decoys.desc: Permanently revokes every regional sublicense granted under a licensing deal. This action cannot be reversed, so it is used once the international team confirms a breach.

set_enum.name: set_license_stage
set_enum.desc: Advances or reverts a licensing deal's stage among negotiating, signed, live, and expired. Content operations relies on this field to know exactly where a title stands in the acquisition pipeline.

decoys.name: forecast_license_stage
decoys.desc: Records the stage a licensing deal is forecast to reach by quarter end, among negotiating, signed, live, and expired. Finance relies on this forecast to plan content spend for the coming quarter.

decoys.name: trigger_license_stage
decoys.desc: Sets the stage at which a licensing deal triggers its marketing launch, among negotiating, signed, live, and expired. Marketing relies on this trigger to time campaign spend for a title.

decoys.name: share_license_stage
decoys.desc: Sets the stage a licensing deal shows to the studio in the partner portal, among negotiating, signed, live, and expired. Studios rely on this field to follow the progress of their titles.

set_bool.name: flag_exclusive
set_bool.desc: Marks a licensing deal as exclusive to the platform, meaning the platform holds sole streaming rights to the title during the term. Marketing depends on this flag when planning launch campaigns.

decoys.name: flag_dubbed
decoys.desc: Marks a licensing deal as dubbed for the platform, meaning localized audio tracks are delivered for the title. Localization depends on this flag when planning release territories.

decoys.name: flag_renewal
decoys.desc: Marks a licensing deal as up for renewal, meaning the term is nearing its end and talks should reopen. Acquisitions depends on this flag when planning the renewal slate.

decoys.name: flag_holdback
decoys.desc: Marks a licensing deal as under a holdback, meaning the title waits out a theatrical window before streaming. Scheduling depends on this flag when planning release dates.

set_ref.name: reassign_studio
set_ref.desc: Transfers a licensing deal from one studio's account to another, updating the counterparty of record. This is typically used when rights change hands between studios mid-negotiation.

decoys.name: sublicense_studio
decoys.desc: Sublicenses a licensing deal from the platform to another studio, adding them as a regional distributor. This is typically used when a partner takes the title into territories outside the platform's reach.

decoys.name: bill_studio
decoys.desc: Bills a licensing deal's delivery costs to another studio's account, updating the payer of record. This is typically used when a co-producer covers the mastering fees.

decoys.name: pitch_studio
decoys.desc: Pitches a licensing deal's remake rights to another studio, logging them as an interested buyer. This is typically used when a format has performed well abroad.

send.name: message_studio
send.desc: Sends a message to the studio associated with a given licensing deal, or to a named studio directly. This is the standard channel content operations uses to relay contractual updates.
child_verbs: reach out to the studio for {obj}

decoys.name: invoice_studio
decoys.desc: Sends an invoice to the studio associated with a given licensing deal, or to a named studio directly. This is the standard channel finance uses to bill for co-marketing costs.
child_verbs: send the studio for {obj} a bill

decoys.name: report_studio
decoys.desc: Sends a viewership report to the studio associated with a given licensing deal, or to a named studio directly. This is the standard channel analytics uses to share title performance.
child_verbs: send a viewership report to the studio behind {obj}
share the viewing numbers for {obj} with its studio

decoys.name: notice_studio
decoys.desc: Sends a formal legal notice to the studio associated with a given licensing deal, or to a named studio directly. This is the standard channel business affairs uses to flag a contract breach.
child_verbs: serve a legal notice on the studio behind {obj}
send the studio for {obj} a formal notice

create.name: create_license
create.desc: Opens a new licensing deal with a studio, with an optional title and starting stage. This is used when acquisitions begins talks on a new title.

decoys.name: create_option
decoys.desc: Opens a new rights option with a studio, with an optional title and starting stage. This is used when acquisitions reserves a title ahead of a full deal.

decoys.name: create_coproduction
decoys.desc: Opens a new co-production with a studio, with an optional title and starting stage. This is used when the platform funds an original alongside a partner.

decoys.name: create_output
decoys.desc: Opens a new output deal with a studio, with an optional title and starting stage. This is used when a studio's future slate is licensed in advance.

list_notes.name: list_license_notes
list_notes.desc: Returns the notes attached to a single licensing deal. It includes every remark content operations has logged against that deal.

decoys.name: list_license_redlines
decoys.desc: Returns the contract redlines attached to a single licensing deal. It includes every markup legal has logged against that deal.

decoys.name: list_license_qc
decoys.desc: Returns the delivery QC reports attached to a single licensing deal. It includes every defect the media team has logged against that deal.

decoys.name: list_license_approvals
decoys.desc: Returns the executive approvals attached to a single licensing deal. It includes every sign-off leadership has logged against that deal.

add_note.name: add_license_note
add_note.desc: Attaches a new note to a licensing deal, with an optional title. It is used to record remarks from content operations.

decoys.name: add_license_redline
decoys.desc: Attaches a new contract redline to a licensing deal, with an optional title. It is used to record a markup from legal.

decoys.name: add_license_qc
decoys.desc: Attaches a new delivery QC report to a licensing deal, with an optional title. It is used to record a defect found by the media team.

decoys.name: add_license_approval
decoys.desc: Attaches a new executive approval to a licensing deal, with an optional title. It is used to record a sign-off from leadership.

update_note.name: update_license_note
update_note.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a licensing deal. It is used to correct or expand a remark after it was logged.

decoys.name: accept_license_redline
decoys.desc: Accepts an existing contract redline on a licensing deal with a comment and an optional title. It is used once legal agrees to the markup.

decoys.name: reply_license_note
decoys.desc: Posts a reply, with an optional title, under an existing note on a licensing deal. It is used when content operations answers a remark.

decoys.name: close_license_qc
decoys.desc: Closes out an existing delivery QC report on a licensing deal with fix details and an optional title. It is used once the studio redelivers the files.

delete_note.name: delete_license_note
delete_note.desc: Permanently removes a note from a licensing deal. The note is erased from the catalog system for good.

decoys.name: reject_license_redline
decoys.desc: Permanently rejects a contract redline on a licensing deal. The markup is struck from the draft for good.

decoys.name: withdraw_license_approval
decoys.desc: Permanently withdraws an executive approval on a licensing deal. The sign-off is voided in the catalog system for good.

decoys.name: dismiss_license_qc
decoys.desc: Permanently dismisses a delivery QC report on a licensing deal. The defect is closed in the media system for good.

set_image.name: set_license_image
set_image.desc: Sets the image shown on a licensing deal record. It is typically the title's key art as supplied by the studio.

decoys.name: set_license_thumbnail
decoys.desc: Sets the row thumbnail on a licensing deal record. It is typically a cropped still chosen by the editorial team.

decoys.name: set_license_billboard
decoys.desc: Sets the homepage billboard on a licensing deal record. It is typically a wide banner designed by marketing.

decoys.name: set_license_ratingcard
decoys.desc: Sets the ratings card image on a licensing deal record. It is typically the certificate issued by a ratings board.

writer.name: draft_text
writer.desc: Writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the licensing deals it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: draft_synopsis
decoys.desc: Writes a title synopsis from a brief, which states the hook in the editor's own words, and the licensing deals it should describe. It returns the finished synopsis.

decoys.name: draft_memo
decoys.desc: Writes a deal memo from a brief, which states the terms in the negotiator's own words, and the licensing deals it covers. It returns the finished memo.

decoys.name: draft_announcement
decoys.desc: Writes a press announcement from a brief, which states the news in the publicist's own words, and the licensing deals it should feature. It returns the finished announcement.

image.name: generate_art
image.desc: Generates an illustration from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: generate_keyart
decoys.desc: Generates a key art concept from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the concept.

decoys.name: generate_thumbnail
decoys.desc: Generates a row thumbnail from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the thumbnail.

decoys.name: generate_poster
decoys.desc: Generates a one-sheet poster from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the poster.

search.name: search_docs
search.desc: Searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the catalog system works.

decoys.name: search_contracts
decoys.desc: Searches the executed contract archive with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up an existing clause.

decoys.name: search_specs
decoys.desc: Searches the delivery spec sheets with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a file format requirement.

decoys.name: search_ratings
decoys.desc: Searches the ratings board guidelines with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a content classification rule.
